ایچ آئی وی ایڈز سے متعلق رپورٹ میں بتایا گیا کہ ملک میں چار لاکھ سترہ ہزار سے زائد افراد اس وائرس کا شکار ہیں، جن میں جنوری دو ہزار پچیس سے جون دو ہزار چھبیس کے دوران رجسٹرڈ ہونے والے تین ہزار نو سو بچے بھی شامل ہیں۔ سندھ اور پنجاب اس حوالے سے سرفہرست ہیں۔

stories.title: Drone Strike Kills 16 Civilians at Ethiopia Displacement Camp in Amhara
stories.summary:
At least 16 civilians were killed and 22 others injured when a drone strike targeted a displacement camp in Ethiopia's northern Amhara region. The attack occurred on Thursday and struck the Hayiq Jari 2 Turk camp near the town of Hayiq, located roughly 430 kilometers northeast of Addis Ababa. According to local residents and conflict monitors, the casualties included three pregnant women, an eight-year-old girl, and several students, while witnesses reported that the camp was hit multiple times at 15-minute intervals.

The facility houses more than 1,800 internally displaced people who previously fled conflict in the Oromia region, including the Wollega area. Residents stated that the bombardment set over 20 shelters on fire, forcing families to flee and separating children from their relatives. The injured victims received initial treatment at Hayiq Hospital, with severe cases transferred to Dessie Hospital for specialized medical care. Conflict tracker Frontlines Ethiopia documented the October 29 incident, with various local accounts noting both drone and artillery fire in the vicinity.

The violent event exacerbates existing humanitarian crises for camp residents who already face severe shortages of food, medicine, and adequate shelter due to prior reductions in aid. The Amhara region has experienced persistent combat between federal security forces and Fano militias since 2023, with military operations frequently impacting civilian populations amid wider national instability involving Tigray and neighboring Eritrea.

stories.title: Macklemore and Aurora Lead Paris Leg of Free Palestine Tour
stories.summary:
American rapper Macklemore brought his Free Palestine Tour to the French capital on October 29, performing alongside Norwegian singer Aurora and various other musicians and activists. This event marked the second stop of a three-date European tour dedicated to supporting Palestinian liberation. The initiative follows Macklemore's removal from Ed Sheeran's US Loop Tour in September, a decision prompted by the Seattle-born artist's onstage statements expressing solidarity with Palestinians in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.

Following his dismissal, Macklemore organized his own concert series to raise funds for organizations that aid the Palestinian people, with all financial proceeds directed to these causes. The European leg commenced in Dublin on October 26 with a sold-out show featuring guest appearances from Hozier and Kneecap, before moving to Paris and concluding in London on October 30. Additional dates in the United States are anticipated to be scheduled soon.

These concerts highlight the ongoing discussions surrounding the responsibilities of performers and their capability to engage in political advocacy despite efforts to silence artists addressing the situation in Palestine. Macklemore has maintained that creators ought to utilize their public platforms to increase awareness and express backing for victims of injustice rather than choosing silence.

The tour has drawn significant public attention and provides a collective space for artists to unite for political expression. Organizers have structured the events to ensure that every monetary contribution directly benefits groups working toward Palestinian liberation and community support.

stories.title: ایف بی آر کا ٹائر سازی کی صنعت میں پیداوار کی الیکٹرانک مانیٹرنگ لازمی قرار دینے کا فیصلہ
stories.summary:
فెڈرل بورڈ آف ریونیو (ایف بی آر) نے ملک میں ٹائر سازی کی صنعت کی پیداوار کی کڑی نگرانی کے لیے ایک نیا قدم اٹھاتے ہوئے الیکٹرانک مانیٹرنگ لازمی قرار دی ہے۔ اس حوالے سے تمام رجسٹرڈ ٹائر مینوفیکچررز کو ہدایت کی گئی ہے کہ وہ تیس نومبر دو ہزار چھبیس تک اپنے فیکٹریز میں مانیٹرنگ سسٹم کو مکمل طور پر فعال بنا دیں۔

نئے احکامات کے مطابق ٹائر فیکٹریوں کے تمام کیورنگ پریسز اور فنشنگ لائنز پر الیکٹرانک مانیٹرنگ سسٹم نصب کیے جائیں گے۔ اس نظام کے تحت تیار ہونے والے ہر ایک ٹائر کی الیکٹرانک گنتی اور شناخت کی جائے گی، جبکہ ٹائر کے قطر، چوڑائی، ٹریڈ ڈیزائن اور وزن کی بنیاد پر اس کی ایس کے یو شناخت کی جائے گی۔

ایف بی آر کا یہ مرکزی کنٹرول سسٹم پیداواری ڈیٹا حقیقی وقت میں حاصل کرے گا، جس سے ڈرائی، مینٹیننس اور وارم اپ سائیکلز کو اصل پیداوار سے الگ شناخت کرنا ممکن ہو گا۔ اس نظام میں کسی بھی قسم کی خرابی، تعطل یا بائی پاس کی فوری نشاندہی ہو جائے گی اور کوئی بھی غیر تیار شدہ ٹائر فیکٹری سے باہر نہیں لے جایا جا سکے گا۔

ٹائر مینوفیکچررز کو اس سسٹم کے لیے درکار ہارڈ ویئر، سافٹ ویئر، کنیکٹیویٹی اور بجلی کی فراہمی خود یقینی بنانی ہوگی۔ متعلقہ چیف کمشنرز ان لینڈ ریونیو اس عمل کے نفاذ کے لیے اپنے فوکل پرسنز نامزد کریں گے اور مینوفیکچررز تمام متعلقہ اخراجات و فیس ادا کرنے کے پابند ہوں گے۔

stories.title: New York State Police to Investigate Campus Sexual Assaults at Cornell
stories.summary:
New York Governor Kathy Hochul announced an agreement on Thursday allowing state police to investigate sexual assault complaints at Cornell University. The arrangement follows widespread criticism regarding the institution's handling of an allegation made by a former student who stated she was gang-raped by seven fraternity members.

Under the newly signed accord, survivors pursuing criminal charges can choose whether state police or the Cornell University Police will lead the investigation. Survivors may alternatively request that the Ithaca Police Department or the Tompkins County Sheriff's Office handle their specific cases. Governor Hochul emphasized that students deserve safe campuses and thorough investigations by properly trained law enforcement.

The agreement stems from renewed attention on the case of a former student, identified as Jane Doe in a civil lawsuit, who reported being drugged and assaulted at the Chi Phi fraternity house in October 2024. Although local prosecutors initially declined to file charges, the criminal investigation was reopened in September 2026. Lawyers representing the accused men have denied the allegations.

In addition to the state police agreement, Governor Hochul appointed New York Attorney General Letitia James as special prosecutor for the criminal inquiry. Former US Deputy Attorney General Sally Yates was also appointed to conduct an independent review of Cornell's management of sexual misconduct complaints, with the police agreement remaining active during this review.

stories.title: وزیراعظم کا یکم نومبر کو گلگت بلتستان کا متوقع دورہ اور ترقیاتی ہدایات
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت اسلام آباد میں ایک اہم اجلاس منعقد ہوا جس میں گلگت بلتستان کے اندر جاری وفاقی حکومت کے ترقیاتی منصوبوں پر ہونے والی پیش رفت کا تفصیلی جائزہ لیا گیا۔ اجلاس کے دوران وزیراعظم نے اعلان کیا کہ عوام کو بنیادی سہولیات کی فراہمی اور ان کے معیار زندگی کو بہتر بنانا حکومت کی اولین ترجیحات میں شامل ہے۔

اجلاس میں اس بات کا بھی ذکر کیا گیا کہ وزیراعظم کا یکم نومبر کو ڈوگرہ راج سے آزادی اور پاکستان سے الحاق کے تاریخی دن کی مناسبت سے گلگت بلتستان کا دورہ متوقع ہے۔ اس موقع پر وزیر اعلیٰ گلگت بلتستان امجد حسین نے بھی خصوصی شرکت کی اور خطے کی ترقی کے حوالے سے امور پر تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا۔

اجلاس میں جولائی میں قائم کی گئی ایک کمیٹی کی رپورٹ بھی پیش کی گئی جس میں پن بجلی کے منصوبوں، بنیادی ڈھانچے اور شمسی توانائی کے پراجیکٹس کا جائزہ لیا گیا۔ وزیراعظم نے ایک سو میگا واٹ کے شمسی توانائی کے پراجیکٹ کو جلد از جلد مکمل کرنے کی ہدایت جاری کی اور نلتر پاور پراجیکٹ، انسداد دہشت گردی کی صلاحیت میں اضافے اور ڈیجیٹل انفرا اسٹرکچر پر بھی گفتگو کی۔

آخر میں وزیراعظم نے متعلقہ وزارتوں اور اداروں کو سختی سے ہدایت کی کہ ترقیاتی کاموں کی رفتار کو تیز کیا جائے اور تمام رکاوٹوں کو ترجیحی بنیادوں پر ختم کیا جائے۔ اجلاس میں وفاقی وزرا احسن اقبال، اعظم نذیر تارڑ، علیم خان، مصدق ملک، عطا اللہ تارڑ، شزا فاطمہ، سردار اویس لغاری، مشیر رانا ثنا اللہ اور محمد علی سمیت دیگر اعلیٰ افسران نے بھی شرکت کی۔

stories.title: Instagram Rings Awards 2026 Honor Global Creators for Cultural Impact
stories.summary:
Instagram has announced the winners of its Rings Awards 2026, recognizing 25 international creators who demonstrate originality, creative risk-taking, and cultural influence across various industries. Unlike conventional popularity rankings based solely on follower counts, the awards emphasize creative vision and the tangible impact individuals make through their work in fashion, sport, music, comedy, design, and entertainment.

Among the prominent figures honored on Thursday are Manchester City striker Erling Haaland, British rapper and actor Little Simz, and American footwear designer Salehe Bembury. The diverse list also features comedy creators Jordan Firstman and Kareem Rahma, alongside other international artists, photographers, filmmakers, and athletes, reflecting Instagram's goal to celebrate creative voices across different disciplines and geographic boundaries.

The winners were selected by a 14-member judging panel consisting of notable figures such as fashion designer Donatella Versace, rapper A$AP Rocky, filmmaker Chloé Zhao, musician FINNEAS, Olympic skier Mikaela Shiffrin, and Instagram head Adam Mosseri. Each recipient receives special Instagram features, including profile customisation options and a gold-coloured ring around their Stories profile pictures.

Additionally, winners are awarded a specially designed physical ring created by American fashion designer Emily Adams Bode Aujla. The ring features a four-leaf clover carved from Connemara marble, symbolizing the concept that creative individuals make their own luck by taking risks and exploring new possibilities. The awards underline how diverse forms of creativity and cultural influence continue to shape online and offline communities globally.

stories.title: ناسا کے سابق خلانورد کا کائنات میں ذہین مخلوق کی موجودگی کا دعویٰ
stories.summary:
ناسا کے سابق خلانورد ونسٹن اسکاٹ نے ایک ٹی وی انٹرویو میں دعویٰ کیا ہے کہ اس کائنات میں انسانوں کے علاوہ بھی ذہین مخلوق کا وجود پایا جاتا ہے۔ تاہم انہوں نے اپنے اس مؤقف میں یہ وضاحت بھی کی کہ انہوں نے زمین پر خلائی مخلوق کی آمد سے متعلق کوئی حتمی بات نہیں کہی اور دونوں موضوعات کو الگ قرار دیا۔

ونسٹن اسکاٹ جو کہ نناوے کی دہائی میں دو خلائی مشنز کا حصہ رہ چکے ہیں، کا کہنا ہے کہ کائنات کے اندر اربوں کی تعداد میں سیارے موجود ہیں۔ ان کا ماننا ہے کہ اتنی بڑی تعداد میں سے بعض سیاروں پر ایسے حالات ضرور بنے ہوں گے جہاں زندگی نے جنم لیا ہو گا اور یہ بات ناممکن ہے کہ پوری وسیع کائنات میں صرف زمین ہی ذہین زندگی کا مسکن ہو۔

یہ بیانات ایسے وقت میں سامنے آئے ہیں جب دوسری طرف امریکی محکمہ دفاع پینٹاگون نے نامعلوم اڑن اشیا کے بارے میں کچھ نئی خفیہ دستاویزات جاری کی ہیں۔ ان رپورٹس کے اندر پراسرار مخلوقات اور امریکا میں نامعلوم فضائی اشیا کی نگرانی سے متعلق مختلف دعوے بھی شامل کیے گئے ہیں۔

واضح رہے کہ خلائی مخلوق کی موجودگی یا عدم موجودگی کے حق میں اب تک کوئی بھی مستند سائنسی ثبوت فراہم نہیں کیا جا سکا ہے۔ سابق خلانورد کا یہ حالیہ بیان صرف ان کے اپنے ذاتی نظریات اور خیالات کی عکاسی کرتا ہے۔

stories.title: West Indies Spinners Leave Bangladesh Struggling on Day Three in Mirpur
stories.summary:
Bangladesh is facing deep trouble on the third day of the first Test in Mirpur, finishing Friday at 79-6 in their second innings. West Indies captain Roston Chase wreaked havoc on the hosts' top order, leaving them with a 106-run lead at stumps. Concussion substitute Jaker Ali and Nayeem Hasan, both unbeaten on 18, were at the crease when bad light forced an early end to play.

Earlier in the day, off-spinner Nayeem took four wickets to bowl out the West Indies for 245, giving Bangladesh a narrow 27-run lead after their first-innings total of 272. The visitors had resumed at 134-4, aided by a crucial fifth-wicket partnership of 65 runs between Tagenarine Chanderpaul, who top-scored with 56, and Justin Greaves, who made 46. Shoriful Islam and Nayeem eventually broke through the resistance before Nayeem cleaned up the tail to finish with figures of 4-33.

In response, the West Indies bowling attack dismantled the Bangladeshi batting lineup. Fast bowler Shamar Joseph struck early before Roston Chase took control, removing Shadman Islam, Towhid Hridoy, and trapping captain Najmul Hossain Shanto lbw. A brief rain interruption halted play for about 30 minutes, after which Jomel Warrican dismissed Litton Das and Mehidy Hasan Miraz.

With Bangladesh reeling at 53-6, Jaker Ali and Nayeem Hasan managed a brief stabilization before stumps. The match situation highlights a dramatic shift in momentum on the third day, placing the West Indies in a strong position as the Test match progresses toward its latter stages.

stories.title: King Charles Faces Reparations Debate During Commonwealth Tour Ahead of Summit
stories.summary:
King Charles is facing renewed pressure regarding historical slavery and the growing reparations movement during his Caribbean tour and ahead of the upcoming Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in Antigua and Barbuda. Since 2022, Charles has expressed sorrow for the suffering caused by slavery, but stopped short of issuing an apology—a line that Britain has consistently resisted. Buckingham Palace has indicated that the King will not apologize on behalf of Britain, which has repeatedly ruled out financial reparations.

Speaking in the Bahamas ahead of the Sunday summit, Charles stated that it is right to acknowledge past suffering and injustices and noted that leaders from affected countries would discuss the issue. However, critics argue this response is inadequate. Niambi Hall Campbell-Dean, chair of the Bahamas' National Reparations Committee, stated that action equal to the scale of the harm inflicted is required rather than carefully crafted words.

Historical records indicate that between the 15th and 19th centuries, European traders abducted and sold at least 12.5 million Africans into slavery, with Britain transporting around 3.2 million people across the Atlantic. While opponents often frame reparations purely as direct financial payments, Caribbean leaders frequently advocate for debt relief, development finance, education, healthcare, and climate resilience to address inequalities rooted in slavery and colonialism.

The monarchy's historical ties have faced increased scrutiny, with Buckingham Palace supporting research into royal connections to slavery in 2023. Furthermore, independent researcher Desiree Baptiste noted that upcoming historical publications will cite records showing that profits from enslaved labor helped fund royal furniture and decorative work commissioned by George IV. Royal commentator Afua Hagan observed that King Charles III remains in a difficult position, as expressing sorrow is distinct from issuing a full apology.

stories.title: Glenn Phillips Smashes Brilliant Century as New Zealand Crush India in T20I
stories.summary:
Glenn Phillips scored a magnificent 107 off 49 balls to lead New Zealand to their highest-ever T20 international score of 259-7 in an 87-run victory over India in Auckland on Friday. Phillips hit ten sixes during his explosive innings and was supported by all-rounder Michael Bracewell, who smashed 65 runs from just 25 balls, including six sixes. The dominant display leveled the momentum in the fourth match of the five-match series.

India won the toss and elected to bowl for the fourth consecutive time. New Zealand initially slipped to 34-2 in the third over and later stumbled to 112-4 in the 11th over after Bevon Jacobs was dismissed. However, a massive 115-run partnership in just 40 balls between Phillips and Bracewell revived the hosts. Phillips accelerated the innings further by hitting four consecutive sixes off Nitish Kumar Reddy in the 16th over, helping New Zealand rack up 85 runs in the final five overs.

In response, India's run chase faltered immediately when Jacob Duffy dismissed openers Sanju Samson and Ishan Kishan in the first over. Requiring 13 runs per over, India continued to lose wickets under pressure as New Zealand's bowlers adapted effectively to the conditions. Captain Mitchell Santner claimed his 150th and 151st T20 international wickets in the ninth over, while Duffy returned to take two wickets in two balls.

Duffy finished with impressive figures of 4-23 from his four overs, and Santner conceded 24 runs while taking two wickets as India were restricted to 172-9. The fifth and final T20 match of the series is scheduled to take place in Hamilton on Sunday.

stories.title: Rickelton and Mulder Lead South Africa Fightback on Day Four Against Australia
stories.summary:
South Africa secured a commanding position on the fourth day of the decisive third Test against Australia at Newlands on Friday. Ryan Rickelton and Wiaan Mulder combined for an unbroken century partnership, sharing 113 runs for the sixth wicket to guide the hosts to 294-5 at tea. This performance stretched South Africa's overall lead to 194 runs as they pursued a challenging target in the series decider.

Resuming the day at 140-4, South Africa lost Matthew Breetzke early for 43 runs when he pulled Australian captain Pat Cummins straight to Mitchell Starc. Despite this breakthrough, Australian bowlers struggled to make further inroads as Rickelton and Mulder adopted a disciplined, measured approach against both spin and seam. Left-hander Rickelton remained unbeaten on 83 at the break, while Mulder was not out on 46, successfully negotiating the afternoon session without losing a wicket.

The resilient partnership shifted momentum on a deteriorating pitch that began showing significant wear by the fourth day. Australian batsman Josh Inglis had previously warned that chasing any target above 200 on the surface would prove difficult. Australia posted 429 in their first innings in response to South Africa's 329, initially claiming a 100-run advantage before the hosts mounted their strong second-innings recovery.

The high-stakes encounter serves as the final match of a three-month series currently tied at 1-1, following Australia's 214-run victory in Durban and South Africa's innings-and-31-run win in Gqeberha. Beyond deciding the series, the match carries immense weight for the world Test rankings, with the ultimate winner capturing the number one spot currently held by Australia. South Africa aims to build an even larger fourth-innings target, while Australia urgently needs early wickets upon resumption.

stories.title: قصور میں زہریلی کھیر کھانے سے ایک ہی خاندان کے پانچ افراد جاں بحق
stories.summary:
صوبہ پنجاب کے ضلع قصور کے قصبہ کنگن پور کے قریب واقع گاؤں محمود خانیکے میں ایک افسوسناک واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں 22 اکتوبر کو زہریلی کھیر کھانے سے ایک ہی خاندان کے پانچ افراد جان کی بازی ہار گئے۔ متاثرہ خاندان میں 55 سالہ کسان قاسم علی، ان کی 52 سالہ اہلیہ حسنہ بی بی اور ان کے تین جوان بیٹے 28 سالہ آصف علی، 25 سالہ ناظم علی اور 15 سالہ امانت علی شامل تھے۔ اس واقعے کا آغاز اس وقت ہوا جب حسنہ بی بی نے ناشتے کے لیے کھیر تیار کی جسے خاندان کے تمام افراد نے تناول کیا۔

کھانے کے بعد دوپہر کے وقت ایک ایک کر کے تمام افراد کی طبیعت خراب ہونا شروع ہو گئی۔ خاندان کے افراد نے ہسپتال جانے کے بجائے روایتی طریقہ اختیار کرتے ہوئے اپنے ہی گاؤں کے ایک روحانی معالج سے رابطہ کیا اور لگاتار تین روز تک دم کرواتے رہے۔ وقت گزرنے کے ساتھ ان کی حالت بگڑتی گئی اور 25 اکتوبر کو انہیں 15 کلومیٹر دور کنگن پور ہسپتال لے جایا گیا جہاں سے انہیں فوری طور پر ڈی ایچ کیو اور پھر جنرل ہسپتال لاہور منتقل کر دیا گیا۔

لاہور کے جنرل ہسپتال پہنچنے پر زہر پورے جسم میں پھیل چکا تھا جس کے باعث اموات کا سلسلہ شروع ہو گیا۔ سب سے پہلے 25 اکتوبر کی رات ناظم علی دم توڑ گیا، جبکہ اگلے روز آصف علی اور امانت علی بھی زندگی کی بازی ہار گئے۔ 27 اکتوبر کو خاندان کے سربراہ قاسم علی بھی علاج کے دوران چل بسے، اور جب 28 اکتوبر کو ان کی تدفین ہو رہی تھی تو ہسپتال سے واحد زندہ بچنے والی حسنہ بی بی کی موت کی اطلاع بھی موصول ہو گئی۔

مقامی پولیس اور ضلعی حکام کے مطابق ابتدائی طور پر یہ ایک حادثاتی واقعہ معلوم ہوتا ہے جس کی باقاعدہ تفتیش کی جا رہی ہے۔ پولیس نے چار افراد کا پوسٹمارٹم کروا کے کھیر اور لاشوں کے نمونے پنجاب فرانزک لیب لاہور بھجوا دیے ہیں۔ دوسری طرف مقامی افراد کا کہنا ہے کہ یہ علاقہ دریائے ستلج کے قریب ہونے کی وجہ سے طبی سہولیات سے محروم ہے اور کم تعلیم کی وجہ سے خاندان نے بروقت ہسپتال جانے کے بجائے دیسی اور روحانی علاج پر انحصار کیا، جس سے یہ قیمتی جانیں ضائع ہو گئیں۔

stories.title: Celine Dion Earns $125.5 Million From Record-Breaking Paris Comeback Concerts
stories.summary:
Canadian superstar Celine Dion reportedly generated $125.5 million from her first 16 comeback concerts in Paris, marking a triumphant return to live performance. Data obtained from Billboard indicated that the 58-year-old singer averaged approximately $7.8 million per show during the initial leg of her residency at Plenitude Arena. Between September 12 and October 17, Dion sold 539,000 tickets, establishing a record for the fastest-grossing residency in history. Building on this success, the five-time Grammy winner is scheduled to perform another 10 shows at the venue in May 2027.

This latest milestone adds to Dion's extensive history of commercially successful concert residencies in Las Vegas. Her landmark production, A New Day..., grossed $385.1 million across 714 performances from 2003 to 2007, while its successor, Céline, brought in $296.2 million over 427 dates between 2011 and 2019.

The triumphant comeback follows a difficult four-year hiatus triggered by her 2022 diagnosis of stiff-person syndrome. The rare neurological condition causes severe muscle stiffness and painful spasms, forcing the vocalist to step away from the stage. Insiders previously revealed that Dion underwent rigorous daily training alongside physical therapy to rebuild her strength and prepare for the demanding residency.

Greeting sold-out crowds in Paris with emotional gratitude, Dion addressed her supporters directly during the opening leg. Expressing relief to be back, she told the audience that she had made a promise to return to the stage to sing live for them and for herself, earning widespread praise from both fans and critics alike.

stories.title: Scottish Police Investigate Former Prince Andrew's Balmoral Stays With Epstein
stories.summary:
Police Scotland have initiated an investigation into information concerning former Prince Andrew's stays at Balmoral Castle alongside convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein and associate Ghislaine Maxwell. According to authorities, Epstein and Maxwell visited the royal estate in the Scottish Highlands back in 1999 following an invitation from Andrew, who held a prince title at the time. A spokesperson for Police Scotland stated that inquiries are currently active and at a very early stage, driven by evidence and prioritizing victim-survivors.

The historic Balmoral Castle, located in the Scottish Highlands, has been owned by the British royal family since 1852 and served as the location where Queen Elizabeth II passed away at age 96 in 2022. Late last year, King Charles stripped his brother of his princely title and dukedom due to his connections with Epstein. Furthermore, Andrew was arrested in February by Thames Valley Police on suspicion of misconduct in public office regarding the sharing of confidential material with the late pedophile, though he denies any wrongdoing.

Prior to his arrest, Andrew's lawyers challenged the lawfulness of police search warrants, and he later launched legal action to contest their validity. Released files from January revealed that Andrew sent Epstein details of his official trips as a trade envoy to Singapore, Vietnam, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong in October 2010, followed by what appeared to be official reports the next month. The ongoing police probe highlights the continuous fallout surrounding the former royal's past associations.

stories.title: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia Strengthen Bilateral Energy and Oil Cooperation
stories.summary:
Pakistan and Saudi Arabia have reached an agreement to enhance collaboration across several key areas, including oil storage, refinery upgrades, liquefied petroleum gas supplies, and minerals. The consensus was finalized during a meeting in Islamabad between Federal Minister for Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik and Saudi Ambassador to Pakistan Dr Rajeh Tami Albugamy. Malik emphasized investment prospects within Pakistan's bonded oil storage policy and the proposed Hub petroleum complex situated in Balochistan, which aims to provide Saudi Arabia with greater flexibility in supply routes and access to broader Asian markets.

The petroleum ministry noted that the proposed complex will feature facilities capable of accommodating very large crude oil carriers. During the discussions, Minister Malik pointed out that the newly approved tax-neutral bonded storage policy allows Saudi companies to establish commercial oil storage facilities inside Pakistan, alongside significant partnership opportunities in the national refinery upgradation program. Both officials reaffirmed their commitment to bolstering energy security and bilateral ties.

In addition to energy matters, Ambassador Albugamy announced the introduction of same-day visa processing for Pakistani citizens to foster business, cultural, and interpersonal connections. This follows recent dialogues between the Saudi envoy and Finance Minister Muhammad Aurangzeb regarding cooperation in agriculture, mining, and other sectors. Prime Minister Shebhas Sharif previously underscored Pakistan's appreciation for advancing relations and maintaining steadfast support for Saudi sovereignty and security.

stories.title: Pakistan Army Destroys Afghan Taliban Posts Following Border Fire
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Army targeted and destroyed several posts and military positions belonging to the Afghan Taliban in areas adjacent to South Waziristan and Parachinar. State-run Radio Pakistan reported on Friday that security sources confirmed the operation, stating that military forces delivered a befitting reply using heavy weaponry to unprovoked firing by the Afghan Taliban in the Angoor Adda area on Thursday, forcing opposing personnel to abandon their positions and flee.

According to security reports, several personnel of the Afghan Taliban regime were killed during the counter-operation. State media emphasized that security forces remain fully committed to defending the country and protecting its population, maintaining that there will be no compromise on national security. The cross-border escalation follows an incident on October 27 when Afghan Taliban forces opened fire on Pakistani border posts and civilian areas in Angoor Adda, Lower South Waziristan. During that earlier incident, mortar shelling struck a residential area, killing one civilian and injuring five members of the same family.

Tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan have persistently strained bilateral relations due to recurring cross-border terrorism and security concerns. Islamabad has continually urged the Afghan Taliban administration to prevent terrorist organizations, notably the Tehreek-e-Insaf Pakistan, from utilizing Afghan territory to launch attacks inside Pakistan, a claim that Kabul has rejected. Following the latest flare-up, Afghanistan's Ministry of Defence accused Pakistani forces of striking Afghan installations, while Pakistan's Ministry of Information and Broadcasting dismissed the account as a fabrication.

In the wake of the border violence, Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi warned the Afghan government that Pakistan would not tolerate ongoing attacks against its population or any violations of its territorial sovereignty. The military actions highlight the volatile security situation along the Pak-Afghan frontier as both nations trade accusations over cross-border stability.

stories.title: Justin and Hailey Bieber Accused of Evicting Carl Lentz Family
stories.summary:
Justin and Hailey Bieber have faced accusations of abruptly ordering former Hillsong pastor Carl Lentz and his family to vacate their New York apartment in the wake of a 2020 infidelity scandal. These claims emerged in a newly published book titled 'Overcoming Infidelity: 10 Conversations to Help You Heal the Hurt', written by Carl and his wife Laura Lentz and released on October 20. According to the publication, the Biebers initially permitted the Lentz family to stay in the apartment while they looked for permanent housing in Brooklyn.

However, after news of Carl's marital infidelity surfaced, someone representing Justin's team reportedly contacted the family and gave them a 24-hour notice to leave. Laura Lentz recalled that she, her husband, and their three children—Ava, Charlie, and Roman—had to hurriedly pack their belongings into a rented vehicle. Carl described the sudden eviction as a severe blow while he was already coping with the fallout of being dismissed from Hillsong Church due to moral failures, admitting that he felt his wife and children suffered as innocent bystanders.

The former pastor acknowledged that his actions damaged his long-standing friendship with Justin, which began back in 2008 when the singer briefly lived with the Lentz family in 2014, and thrust the celebrity couple into an unwanted publicity nightmare. Despite the challenges, Carl and Laura credited actor Tyler Perry for providing support to their family during a period when many friends remained silent.

stories.title: Neeraj Chopra Aims for Training Return Following Ligament Injury Recovery
stories.summary:
India's double Olympic javelin medalist Neeraj Chopra has announced that his recovery from a ligament tear is progressing favorably, with expectations to resume training and rehabilitation within the upcoming weeks. The 28-year-old athlete was forced to curtail his 2026 season prematurely following a training injury sustained back in August. Following medical advice, Chopra focused entirely on rest and recovery after finishing as the runner-up at the Lausanne Diamond League meeting in August, where he recorded an 88.05-meter throw.

Chopra's current health status marks a critical step forward after being sidelined for months from competitive action. As the reigning world champion, his absence from the sport has been closely watched by fans and sporting authorities alike. The Sports Authority of India shared his encouraging update on Instagram on Friday, confirming that the javelin star is steadily moving past the setback.

Having secured significant global achievements, including an Olympic gold medal in Tokyo followed by a silver medal in Paris, Chopra remains a central figure in Indian athletics. His anticipated return to training signals the first major milestone in his physical rehabilitation and preparations to re-enter international competition once fully healed from the ligament damage.

stories.title: Six People Killed in Uttarakhand Helicopter Crash in India
stories.summary:
A tragic helicopter crash in the northern Indian Himalayan state of Uttarakhand resulted in the deaths of all six individuals on board, according to a local civil aviation official. The aircraft was traveling from the mountainous Hindu pilgrimage destination of Badrinath to Dehradun when the accident occurred. Prateek Jain, Chief Executive Officer of the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority, confirmed that the fatalities included five passengers and the pilot.

According to the authority, the chopper lost communication and vanished from tracking systems while flying over the Joshimath valley. Following the incident, the Uttarakhand Civil Aviation Development Authority grounded the entire fleet belonging to the operator, Trans Bharat Aviation, as a precautionary measure. The company did not immediately respond to requests for comment from media outlets regarding the crash.

Authorities launched a joint search and rescue operation involving the district administration, disaster management teams, and regional troops. Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami stated on social media that his office had received reports of the crash near a village in the Joshimath area and noted that he was personally monitoring the situation. Television broadcasts showed smoke and fire at the crash site as rescue workers rushed to the location.

The incident highlights ongoing safety concerns in mountainous aviation and has drawn significant attention. Regional officials continue to manage the aftermath of the disaster, while investigations into the exact cause of the communication loss and subsequent crash are expected to proceed.

stories.title: Pakistan to Face Sri Lanka in Lahore ODI Tri-Series Final
stories.summary:
Pakistan and Sri Lanka are set to face off in the upcoming One Day International tri-series final at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore. Pakistan enters the title clash following an eight-wicket defeat against the same opponent in their final league match. The tournament hosts have spent two days in intensive training to address persistent weaknesses, particularly within their struggling top-order batting lineup.

Pakistan's batting struggles have been a major talking point throughout the series. Opener Saim Ayub was recently replaced in the squad by T20 captain Sahibzada Farhan, who made a hurried journey from Nepal. Other prominent batters, including Fakhar Zaman and Babar Azam, have also experienced dips in form. Despite these challenges, senior batsman Salman Ali Agha expressed confidence during a news conference, stating that the team could secure a comfortable victory if they played to their full potential and if the top order performed.

Meanwhile, Sri Lanka enters the final match displaying exceptional batting form. The visiting team's top order has delivered consistently, highlighted by Pavan Rathnayake scoring two centuries. Sri Lanka previously made history by successfully chasing a record 430 runs against England, the second-highest run chase in ODI cricket history, and demonstrated further depth when confronting a 387-run target.

Head coach Mike Hesson and senior players have emphasized the need for Pakistan to deliver a complete performance. Salman defended his out-of-form teammates, noting that inconsistency is common in international sport. The final promises a challenging test for the hosts as they attempt to overcome Sri Lanka's momentum and claim the tri-series trophy.

stories.title: Political Tensions Mount as Russian Athletes Return to International Sport
stories.summary:
The participation of Russian athletes at the Youth Olympics in Dakar, Senegal, has renewed intense debate over the neutrality of international sports. International Olympic Committee President Kirsty Coventry has maintained that sport should remain neutral ground, free from political interference. However, Ukrainian officials and former sports executives argue that separating athletics from global politics is impossible, particularly following the 2022 invasion of Ukraine ordered by Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Under the current arrangements, 13 Russian athletes are permitted to compete, parade with their national flag, and hear their national anthem at an Olympic event for the first time since 2020. Ukrainian Sports Minister Matviy Bidnyi strongly condemned the decision, stating that the isolation of Russian athletes is a matter of basic human decency rather than politics, and that normalization should only occur after the war ends and international law is restored. Conversely, former marketing executives like Terrence Burns argue that sport has never truly been separate from politics, emphasizing that the primary objective should be maintaining institutional independence from governments.

The debate also touches upon historical boycotts, such as those affecting Summer Olympics between 1976 and 1984, which former marketing chief Michael Payne noted nearly crippled the Olympic movement. While most boycotts failed to achieve their political goals, selective actions like the campaign against apartheid South Africa demonstrated effectiveness when sustained collectively. Analysts note that sport is increasingly being weaponized by politicians seeking to dictate participation rules.

In addition to the Olympics, FIFA President Gianni Infantino has faced severe criticism for easing bans on Russian participation at youth levels and maintaining close ties with political figures like US President Donald Trump. While sporting events have occasionally fostered brief moments of unity, such as joint appearances by North and South Korea, critics warn that readmitting aggressor nations sends a dangerous signal to the international community.

stories.title: Marco Rubio Hosts G20 Ministerial Amid Deep Divisions Over Global Conflicts
stories.summary:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting Group of 20 foreign ministers this week, with the summit facing intense diplomatic strain over Russia's war in Ukraine and ongoing fallout from conflicts involving Iran. Diplomatic sources indicate that the G20 can no longer achieve broad consensus on formal statements, prompting the US presidency to structure the Atlanta summit around displays of American power, economic growth, and trade commitments rather than substantive declarations.

The US administration intends to issue a chair summary rather than a traditional final communique. Washington aims to steer the forum back toward economic prosperity and supply chain security, arguing that geopolitical shocks directly affect global energy markets. Surging energy prices resulting from US-Israel strikes on Iran and the subsequent blockade of the Strait of Hormuz remain a central focus, with Washington pushing for international agreement on freedom of navigation.

Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov's presence at the gathering has added further tension, frustrating European ministers as Washington continues diplomatic engagement with Moscow ahead of upcoming talks in November. Meanwhile, China has sent a deputy instead of top diplomat Wang Yi, following earlier Chinese pushback regarding free navigation terminology. The outcomes of this week's meetings will heavily influence the upcoming December G20 summit in Miami, where President Trump has extended an invitation to Russian President Vladimir Putin.

stories.title: حنا جاوید قتل کیس: قومی اسمبلی کی قائمہ کمیٹی کی پولیس کو دوبارہ تفتیش کی تجویز
stories.summary:
قومی اسمبلی کی قائمہ کمیٹی برائے امور داخلہ نے حنا جاوید قتل کیس میں مقتولہ کے اہلخانہ کے تحفظات کا جائزہ لینے کے لیے پولیس کو دوبارہ تفتیش کرنے کی سفارش کی ہے۔ کرائم کنٹرول ڈیپارٹمنٹ کے ایڈیشنل آئی جی سہیل ظفر چھٹہ نے کمیٹی کو بریفنگ دی کہ فرانزک شواہد اور ڈی این اے رپورٹس کی بنیاد پر گھریلو ملازم اس قتل اور مبینہ ریپ کا مرکزی ملزم دکھائی دیتا ہے، جبکہ وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب کی ہدایت پر قائم خصوصی کمیٹی نے بھی اہلِ خانہ سے ملاقات اور اڈیالہ جیل میں ملزمان سے پوچھ گچھ کے بعد سفارشات تیار کی ہیں۔

دوسری جانب مقتولہ کے اہلِ خانہ نے پولیس کی تحقیقات پر عدم اعتماد کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے مؤقف اپنایا کہ انہیں فرانزک رپورٹس نہیں دی گئیں اور ابتدائی طور پر کیس کو غلط سمت دی گئی، جبکہ وہ آزادانہ انکوائری اور جوڈیشل کمیشن کے قیام کا مطالبہ بھی کر رہے ہیں۔ پیپلز پارٹی کی رہنما آصفہ زرداری نے بھی پارلیمنٹ میں اہلِ خانہ سے ملاقات کرکے انصاف کی جدوجہد میں مکمل حمایت کا یقین دلایا۔ یاد رہے کہ 20 اگست کی صبح 45 سالہ حنا جاوید کی برہنہ لاش ان کے راولپنڈی والے گھر کے باتھ روم سے برآمد ہوئی تھی جس پر ان کے شوہر، سسر اور گھریلو ملازم کے خلاف تھانہ سول لائنز میں مقدمہ درج کیا گیا تھا۔

پولیس ٹیم کا دعویٰ ہے کہ مقتولہ کا خاوند ڈاکٹر فیصل اصغر بے گناہ ہے اور ملازم ذیشان کا ڈی این اے، ناخنوں کے ذرات اور اعتراف جرم اس بات کو ثابت کرتے ہیں کہ اس نے مزاحمت پر حنا جاوید کا گلہ گھونٹ کر قتل کیا اور بعد ازاں ریپ کیا۔ تفتیشی ٹیم کے مطابق مقتولہ کے شوہر کے فنگر پرنٹس بستر کی چادر اور دروازے کے ہینڈل پر ملے تھے لیکن وہ اس قتل میں ملوث ہونے کو ثابت کرنے کے لیے کافی نہیں ہیں۔

مقدمے کی اس کارروائی کے پس منظر میں وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز نے بھی سوشل میڈیا پر کیس کی تفتیش اور بروقت کارروائی کا ذکر کیا جبکہ صحافیوں اور خاندان کی طرف سے شفاف تحقیقات اور جوڈیشل کمیشن کے مطالبات بدستور جاری ہیں۔

stories.title: Aima Baig Shares Heartfelt Rendition of Hit Track 'Sajna Door'
stories.summary:
Pakistani singer Aima Baig surprised her followers by sharing a spontaneous rendition of her popular song Sajna Door on Instagram. Baig posted the brief performance to express gratitude to her fanbase for continuing to keep the track trending years after its initial release. Having no immediate access to musical instruments at the moment, she recorded a quick vocal version and playfully apologized to her followers for a visible metronome in the background.

Alongside the impromptu performance, Baig promised her supporters that she would soon host a live session allowing them to sing the beloved track together. The original song was released as part of the soundtrack for the 2018 romantic action-comedy film Teefa in Trouble. It featured vocals by Baig alongside singer-songwriter Ali Zafar, receiving widespread praise for its mellow romantic atmosphere and bilingual Urdu, Punjabi, and English lyrics.

The track's original music video, directed by Ahsan Rahim, famously featured Ali Zafar and Maya Ali performing dreamy sequences, including a memorable scene of the couple dancing on water. Baig's recent social media tribute has successfully thrust the classic hit back into the spotlight. In addition to connecting with fans through this musical throwback, the singer is reportedly working on her upcoming debut album titled Guriya, which is dedicated to her late mother.

stories.title: Trump Cancels Rallies and Lashes Out at Reporter Before Midterms
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump is scrapping two of his final in-person midterm election rallies, the Republican Party announced on Thursday, as the 80-year-old leader lashed out at a journalist who questioned his travel schedule. Returning to Washington following a campaign trip to Rock Hill, South Carolina, to support incumbent Senator Darline Graham, Trump reacted angrily when a Reuters reporter asked if he was sick of traveling and how he felt after weeks of campaigning. Calling the reporter sick and disgusting, Trump stated that he felt perfect before boarding his motorcade back to the White House.

Later on Thursday, the Republican National Committee confirmed that planned in-person rallies in Salina, Kansas, on Saturday, and Dubuque, Iowa, on Sunday, would no longer take place. Instead of attending these events in person, Trump will host a large number of virtual tele-rallies across multiple states. The adjustments come as Republicans fight to maintain narrow control of Congress in the November 3 midterm elections, with Trump urging supporters to maximize turnout despite his poor approval ratings.

Despite the cancellations, the president is still expected to travel for rallies in several states, with his final election rally scheduled for Florida on Friday. Throughout October, Trump has maintained a grueling campaign schedule, hosting 25 rallies across 19 states since October 1 to assist Republican candidates in tight races, such as Senator Roger Marshall's competitive contest against Democratic challenger Adam Hamilton in Kansas. MAGA Inc, a campaign funding group aligned with Trump, stated it will host tele-rallies featuring the president in at least 19 states ahead of Election Day.

Trump has previously acknowledged the physical strain of his extensive campaign speeches, noting earlier in the week in Mississippi that human vocal cords are not made to sustain a rally every single day. The upcoming November 3 elections will ultimately decide whether Republicans retain their narrow majorities in both the US Senate and the House of Representatives.

stories.title: آسٹریا میں افغان سفیر منیژہ باختری کا طالبان احکامات کے خلاف احتجاجی عزم
stories.summary:
سنہ 2021 میں افغانستان میں اشرف غنی کی حکومت کے خاتمے اور طالبان کے اقتدار میں آنے کے بعد، آسٹریا میں افغانستان کی سفیر منیژہ باختری کو عہدہ چھوڑنے کی ہدایت کی گئی تھی۔ انہوں نے طالبان کا یہ مطالبہ ماننے سے صاف انکار کر دیا اور وہ خود کو ’آخری سفیر‘ کہلاتی ہیں۔ بی بی سی کو دیے گئے ایک انٹرویو میں انہوں نے بتایا کہ حکومت کے خاتمے کے بعد وہ چوبیس گھنٹوں تک شدید ذہنی پریشانی میں مبتلا رہیں کہ اب کیا کیا جائے۔

انہوں نے سوچا کہ چونکہ وہ ایک خاتون ہیں، اس لیے طالبان حکومت انہیں اس منصب پر نہیں دیکھنا چاہیں گی۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ انہیں ایک منتخب حکومت نے ملک اور عوام کی نمائندگی کے لیے باہر بھیجا تھا، اس لیے وہ اپنے فرائض سے پیچھے کیوں ہٹتیں۔ اگر وہ استعفیٰ دے دیتیں تو سفارتخانے اور وہاں موجود حساس دستاویزات کا تحفظ خطرے میں پڑ جاتا۔ اس کے باوجود کہ طالبان حکام انہیں برطرف کر چکے ہیں، وہ آج بھی بطورِ احتجاج اپنے عہدے پر کام جاری رکھے ہوئے ہیں اور سفارتخانہ اپنے اصولوں اور شرائط پر چلا رہی ہیں۔

منیژہ باختری کابل میں پیدا ہوئیں اور ایک متوسط طبقے کے خاندان سے تعلق رکھتی ہیں۔ ان کے والد ایک معروف شاعر، ادیب اور مفکر تھے جنہیں مجاہدین کے دور میں خیالات کی بنیاد پر جیل جانا پڑا تھا۔ نوے کی دہائی میں طالبان کے کابل میں داخل ہونے پر خاندان کو شدید خطرات لاحق ہوئے، جس کے بعد ان کے والد نے ملک چھوڑ دیا جبکہ ان کا خاندان پاکستان منتقل ہو گیا۔ اس مشکل سفر کے دوران انہیں شدید پریشانیوں کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔

امریکہ اور برطانیہ کے حملوں کے بعد طالبان حکومت کے خاتمے پر وہ کابل واپس لوٹیں، جسے انہوں نے اپنی زندگی کا بہترین لمحہ قرار دیا۔ واپسی کے بعد وہ کابل یونیورسٹی میں لیکچرار اور ایک این جی او سے وابستہ تھیں جب وزارتِ خارجہ نے انہیں سفارتکاری کے شعبے میں کام کرنے کی دعوت دی۔ یہ ان کے لیے ایک بڑا امتحان تھا کیونکہ انہیں تدریس اور اپنے بچپن کے خواب کو چھوڑنا پڑا۔

سنہ 2021 میں کابل کا کنٹرول دوبارہ طالبان کے پاس جانے پر انہوں نے طالبان کی زوم میٹنگ میں شرکت سے انکار کر دیا۔ سال 2022 میں انہیں باضابطہ طور پر برطرفی کا خط موصول ہوا، لیکن عالمی برادری کی جانب سے طالبان کو تسلیم نہ کیے جانے کے تناظر میں انہوں نے احتجاجاً اپنے عہدے پر رہنے کا فیصلہ کیا تاکہ وہ طالبان کے سامنے ہتھیار نہ ڈالیں۔

stories.title: London Exhibition Celebrates Agatha Christie's Life and Crime Novels
stories.summary:
A new London exhibition titled "Agatha Christie: A World of Mystery" opened at the British Library on Friday to mark 50 years since the author's death. The display provides a comprehensive look into the life, personal interests, travels, and inspirations of the celebrated crime novelist, offering visitors insight into how the woman known as the Queen of Crime created her timeless whodunnits and iconic characters such as Hercule Poirot and Miss Marple.

Curated across five immersive sections, the exhibition features early drafts, letters, photographs, and personal belongings, including a typewriter used by the author. James Prichard, Christie's great-grandson and CEO of Agatha Christie Limited, noted that the display sheds light on the person behind the work by showcasing unexpected personal moments, such as photographs of her surfing and roller skating, alongside the creative genesis of her stories and the real backgrounds behind the poisons she frequently employed in her plots.

The layout begins with a mock country house reflecting Christie's childhood in Torquay and the settings of many novels, followed by a dispensary setup featuring poison bottles that references her volunteer work as a nurse and pharmacy dispenser during World War One. A 1920s train carriage layout explores her extensive travels and the inspiration behind works like "Murder on the Orient Express," while remaining sections feature a makeshift 1930s archaeological dig site highlighting her support for archaeological excavations and a theater setting dedicated to stage adaptations of her books.

Born in the English seaside town of Torquay in 1890, Agatha Christie remains the best-selling novelist of all time. Her extensive collection of detective fiction and plays has achieved global sales exceeding two billion copies, cementing her enduring legacy in literary history.

stories.title: Russell Brand's Wife Testifies at His London Rape and Assault Trial
stories.summary:
Laura Gallacher, the wife of British comedian and actor Russell Brand, testified as a character witness at his London trial on Thursday. Brand is facing seven counts of rape, sexual assault, and attempted indecent assault involving six women between 1999 and 2009. If convicted, the 51-year-old faces up to life in prison, though he has pleaded not guilty to all charges, maintaining that his past promiscuity always involved consensual encounters.

During her testimony, the 39-year-old described her husband as caring, kind, and an amazing, attentive partner and father to their three children. The couple began dating in 2006 after meeting when she was 19, and they later married in 2017. Gallacher stated that although Brand treated her caringly and at her own pace, she eventually realized he was engaging with other women and broke up with him temporarily because she refused to share a partner. She told the court that it was clear he found monogamy difficult and that she was well aware of his publicized promiscuity.

The trial has reached its final stages, with the jury expected to retire for deliberations on Tuesday. The London court previously heard accounts from six women concerning alleged offenses committed while Brand rose to fame as a stand-up comedian and television presenter. On Wednesday, Brand acknowledged that he had been obsessed with sex and used his fame to facilitate access.

Additional statements from former girlfriends were read into the record during the proceedings, including testimony from Elia Alvarez Diaz, who dated Brand in the 1990s and described him as unfaithful and promiscuous. Brand was previously married to American pop star Katy Perry from 2010 to 2011. Gallacher's supportive testimony concluded as the case moved closer to its verdict, drawing significant public attention in the UK.

stories.title: Major Fire Razes Karachi Furniture Market and Shuts Down Area
stories.summary:
A large fire broke out late Thursday night at an open-air furniture market near Kamran Chowrangi in Karachi's Gulistan-e-Jauhar area, destroying roughly 35 shops and 10 to 12 shanties. The blaze also impacted an adjacent residential building, but firefighters managed to contain it there before it could cause widespread structural damage. Fortunately, no casualties were reported from the incident, which caused heavy financial losses for local merchants.

The Karachi Metropolitan Corporation Fire Brigade received the emergency alert at 1:35 am, and units arrived at the scene within ten minutes. However, strong winds and dry weather caused the flames to spread rapidly across the market, which local traders noted had been operating for about 50 years. To maintain adequate water pressure, an emergency was declared at the Safoora hydrant following a request by Chief Fire Officer Humayun Khan. Police, Rangers, and K-Electric teams were also deployed, with power to the surrounding area cut off as a precautionary measure.

A multi-agency firefighting effort involving the KMC Fire Brigade, Rescue 1122, and other departments deployed multiple fire tenders and a water bowser. Firefighters brought the blaze under control after roughly an hour and a half, while cooling operations extended until approximately 5 am. Affected shopkeepers appealed to the Sindh government for financial aid, stating that valuable furniture worth millions of rupees was destroyed and their livelihoods wiped out within hours. Chief Fire Officer Khan noted that dry weather often increases fire risks and suggested that a spark from the nearby shanties might have ignited the market.

The incident follows a series of major fire safety concerns across Pakistan, including a recent blaze at a Landhi Export Processing Zone factory and a tragic hospital fire in Islamabad that killed 14 babies. It also echoes the aftermath of a massive January 2026 fire at the Gul Plaza shopping mall in Karachi, which killed over 70 people and prompted judicial inquiries into widespread safety violations and inadequate enforcement across commercial and public buildings in the province.

stories.title: Asim Azhar Celebrates 30th Birthday and Releases New Single 'Ajnabi'
stories.summary:
Pakistani singer Asim Azhar celebrated his 30th birthday by treating his listeners to a brand-new track titled 'Ajnabi'. Azhar announced the release of the song via an Instagram video filmed on the streets of London, dedicating the release as a personal gift to anyone who has found or continues to find love. The music video for 'Ajnabi' was concurrently made available on YouTube for his fans.

Alongside the music release, Azhar shared a birthday photo dump on Instagram to express gratitude for the love and messages he received. The carousel of images featured heartfelt snapshots with his family and parents, playful photos, and a custom birthday cake decorated with a childhood picture of the singer wearing a birthday hat. Another slide humorously showed him standing behind a poster declaring that he was a year older and hotter.

However, it was the ninth slide of Azhar's birthday post that generated widespread speculation among fans. The video clip showed the singer riding kick scooters around a neighborhood alongside actor Hania Aamir. The appearance closely followed an Instagram story shared by Aamir earlier that day, which featured her riding scooters with an unidentified male companion while Azhar's new song played in the background.

The overlapping social media posts quickly fueled rumors among fans that the former couple might be rekindling their relationship, particularly after they were recently spotted together at multiple public events. Neither Azhar nor Aamir has issued a public confirmation regarding a romantic reunion. Nevertheless, the combination of his milestone birthday, the drop of 'Ajnabi', and Aamir's appearance in his photo album provided plenty of material for followers to discuss online.

stories.title: Lahore High Court Directs Counsel to File Separate Plea for Noreen Niazi
stories.summary:
The Lahore High Court instructed the legal counsel representing Noreen Niazi, the sister of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf founder Imran Khan, to submit a separate civil miscellaneous application. This application must formally address her medical treatment and request permission for her family to visit her in the hospital following her recent health decline while in preventive detention.

Seventy-year-old Noreen Niazi was transferred to the Punjab Institute of Cardiology on Wednesday after falling ill in custody. Justice Abher Gul Khan issued the directives during a hearing for a petition filed by Sakeena Niazi, which challenges the ongoing detention of Imran Khan's sisters, Noreen and Dr Uzma Khan, under the Maintenance of Public Order law. During the proceedings, defense lawyer Rana Mudassar Umer questioned the necessity of extending the detention orders, arguing that the fresh notifications were identical to previous ones.

PTI Secretary General Salman Akram Raja also attended the hearing to voice deep concerns regarding Noreen Niazi's medical status, stating she was moved to the intensive care unit without adequate family notification. Family members and party leaders strongly condemned the continuous detention of elderly female relatives, asserting that they are being held unjustly to cause distress to the family while lacking the resilience required for solitary confinement.

stories.title: MIT Solutions Defeats State Bank to Claim President's Trophy Championship
stories.summary:
MIT Solutions triumphed over the State Bank of Pakistan by 51 runs in the President's Trophy Grade-1 final held at the Bagh-e-Jinnah Ground in Lahore. Defending a target of 237, MIT Solutions bowled out SBP for 185 runs on the fourth day of the match, overcoming a 60-run first-innings deficit to secure the title.

Left-arm spinner and MIT Solutions captain Khalid Usman delivered a stellar bowling performance, taking 4 wickets for 38 runs to dismantle the opponent's batting lineup. Teammate and fast bowler Aamer Jamal earned the man of the final award after contributing 55 runs in the second innings and finishing with match figures of 8-71, cementing his crucial all-round impact.

Individual tournament accolades were also distributed following the conclusion of the season. Taimur Khan of Pakistan Television was recognized as the player of the tournament and best stumper, while SBP's Sirajuddin was named best bowler with 32 wickets. Hasan Raza of SBP claimed the best batsman award after scoring 807 runs across eight matches with an impressive average of 62.07.

stories.title: وقار یونس کا انڈین پوڈ کاسٹ انٹرویو: بابر اعظم کا دفاع اور کھلاڑیوں کا موازنہ
stories.summary:
پاکستان کرکٹ ٹیم کے سابق ہیڈ کوچ اور لیزمینڈ وقار یونس نے ایک انڈین پوڈ کاسٹ میں شرکت کی جہاں انھوں نے موجودہ بیٹر بابر اعظم کا بھرپور دفاع کیا۔ انڈین پوڈ کاسٹر شبھنکر مشرا کے ساتھ گفتگو کرتے ہوئے وقار یونس کا کہنا تھا کہ بابر اعظم پر اس وقت اضافی دباؤ ہے کیونکہ وہ اکیلے میچ جتوانے کی کوشش کر رہے ہیں، جبکہ نوے کی دہائی میں پاکستان کے پاس بیک وقت کئی میچ ونرز اور ٹاپ کے کھلاڑی موجود ہوا کرتے تھے۔

پوڈ کاسٹ کے دوران ریپڈ فائر سیشن میں وقار یونس نے کئی انڈین اور پاکستانی کھلاڑیوں کا موازنہ کیا۔ انھوں نے انضمام الحق کے مقابلے میں س Sachin ٹنڈولکر، بابر اعظم کے مقابلے میں ویرات کوہلی، اور شاہین آفریدی کے مقابلے میں جسپریت بمراہ کو ترجیح دی۔ تاہم، کپل دیو کے مقابلے میں انھوں نے عمران خان کا انتخاب کیا۔ اس کے علاوہ، جاوید میانداد کے مقابلے میں ایم ایس دھونی کو ترجیح دینے پر انہیں جاوید میانداد کے بھانجے فیصل اقبال کی طرف سے سخت تنقید کا سامنا بھی کرنا پڑا۔

سوشل میڈیا پر وقار یونس کے ان بیانات پر ملا جلا ردعمل دیکھنے میں آیا۔ جہاں کچھ مداحوں نے ان کے اس مؤقف کو سراہا کہ کرکٹ ایک ٹیم گیم ہے اور بابر کو اردگرد سے خاطر خواہ تعاون نہیں مل رہا، وہیں کچھ صارفین اور ناقدین نے ان کی جانب سے انڈین کھلاڑیوں اور سابق کپتان دھونی کو ترجیح دینے کے فیصلے پر ناپسندیدگی کا اظہار کیا۔

وقار یونس نے پاک بھارت میچوں کے حوالے سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ دونوں ٹیموں کے درمیان باقاعدہ اور تسلسل کے ساتھ میچز نہ ہونے کی وجہ سے کھلاڑی دباؤ میں آ جاتے ہیں اور بہترین کارکردگی سامنے نہیں آ पाती۔ انہوں نے جاوید میانداد کے تاریخی چھکے کا بھی ذکر کیا جس نے اس دور میں پاک بھارت کرکٹ کو ایک نئی لہر دی تھی۔

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Snaps Four-Day Winning Streak Amid Profit-Taking
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange experienced a downturn, with the benchmark KSE-100 Index shedding 784.19 points, or 0.47 percent, to close at 166,409.25 points. Trading volume reached approximately 235 million shares as investors engaged in profit-taking following four consecutive sessions of market gains.

Despite the single-day decline, the market recorded a solid weekly performance with a 2.5 percent gain, recovering from levels near 161,000 points. Analysts noted that this positive weekly trajectory was primarily aided by the State Bank of Pakistan's decision to limit its policy rate increase to a modest 50 basis points, helping contain monetary tightening pressures.

External economic factors, particularly rising global oil prices, continued to weigh on investor sentiment. Brent crude climbed approximately 2.5 percent to trade near $118 per barrel, exacerbating external account and inflationary concerns. Major sectors such as commercial banks, cements, and refineries led the market's losses, while upcoming international political events and regional developments are expected to dictate market direction in the coming week.

stories.title: Security Forces in Balochistan Intercept and Destroy Five Drones
stories.summary:
Security forces in Balochistan's Kharan district successfully intercepted and destroyed five low-grade drones before they reached their intended targets. According to state media and security sources, the drones were deployed by a group designated by the federal government as Fitna al-Hindustan, which authorities accuse of acting as an Indian-sponsored proxy. The attack targeted a checkpost in the Albat area.

This incident is part of a broader security challenge in Pakistan, where terrorism has seen a significant rise since 2022. Global monitoring organization Armed Conflict Location & Event Data reported that attacks nationwide increased nearly fourfold from 658 in 2022 to 2,425 in 2025. In Balochistan, militants frequently target civilian and military installations, convoys, and personnel.

Earlier in the week, the National Assembly received figures from the interior ministry stating that security forces had neutralized 2,410 terrorists, injured 806, and arrested 3,518 during 5,143 intelligence-based operations in the first nine months of 2026. These figures were shared alongside anti-terrorism and online extremism measures under the National Action Plan.

Despite ongoing operations across the provinces, militant groups continue to target defence and civilian assets. A recent abduction in the province involved 20 trainee police personnel traveling between Kalat and Mastung. Security forces maintain their operations against these groups while attempting to secure both the province and the country's critical infrastructure.

stories.title: Russian Drone Strike Kills 14 on Ukrainian Railway Platform
stories.summary:
A Russian jet-powered drone strike killed at least 14 people on a crowded rail platform in the Ukrainian city of Dnipro on Thursday. The attack occurred at the city's main station as a commuter train was preparing to depart. State railway Ukrzaliznytsia reported the strike, which left mangled bodies and pools of blood across the shrapnel-marked pavement while police handled body bags amid blaring air-raid sirens.

Additional strikes across Ukraine on the same day resulted in five more deaths in two other cities. In Chernihiv in northern Ukraine, two teenage girls were killed on a central street, while three people died in Kremenchuk from strikes on residential buildings. Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergiy Koretskyi condemned the attacks on the Telegram app, stating that Russia is deliberately targeting civilians.

These attacks took place against the backdrop of an acute shortage of air defence missiles in Ukraine, leaving critical infrastructure and civilian life vulnerable to ongoing drone and missile strikes. Meanwhile, a localized six-day truce, brokered with United States help, was implemented solely in the southern Kherson region to facilitate a humanitarian mission providing relief to the Russian-held town of Oleshky.

The broader conflict has severely impacted Ukraine's economy and civilian routine since the start of Russia's invasion in 2022. Critical infrastructure, including the national railway network, has frequently been targeted, further compounding the humanitarian crisis across multiple urban centers.

stories.title: Think Tank Warns New Provinces Will Bring Heavy Fiscal Burden
stories.summary:
A private think tank, the Policy Research Institute of Market Economy, released a market analysis on Thursday cautioning that the creation of new provinces in Pakistan would carry significant fiscal costs that likely outweigh administrative benefits. The institute advised prioritizing stronger local governments over new provinces if the actual goal is to improve public service delivery.

The analysis estimates that creating two additional provinces, specifically South Punjab, Bahawalpur, and the remaining Punjab, would introduce an extra annual recurring cost of Rs47 billion to Rs57 billion. Upgrading all 30 divisional units to provincial status would elevate this recurring financial burden up to Rs730 billion. The think tank recommended conducting formal fiscal costing exercises before pursuing constitutional changes.

Under an illustrative National Finance Commission allocation, if the country has six provinces, South Punjab would receive Rs1 trillion while Bahawalpur would get Rs537 billion. Conversely, a 30-province model would yield vast disparities, allocating between Rs7,201 billion for Lahore and Rs50 billion for Zhob, with 11 units receiving less than Rs150 billion annually.

Using a 10 percent fiscal sustainability benchmark, the study found that 16 of the 30 proposed provinces would remain at or below the threshold, while 14 would exceed it. Small units would be hit hardest, with core government structures consuming nearly half of Loralai's allocation and over a third for other small populations. Consequently, smaller provinces would see reduced fiscal room for public services and development.

stories.title: State Bank of Pakistan Launches SMEConnect Digital Financing Portal
stories.summary:
The State Bank of Pakistan has launched SMEConnect, a centralized digital platform intended to simplify loan applications and financing accessibility for small and medium enterprises across the country. Operating as a single digital channel, the platform aims to streamline the financing process and improve transparency for a sector viewed as crucial to the national economy.

Historically, financial institutions and development finance institutions have been hesitant to take risks with SMEs, preferring instead to invest in risk-free government papers to secure higher returns. Just prior to the portal's launch, financial institutions offered Rs4.9 trillion for treasury bills, prompting the government to raise Rs1.9 trillion. Furthermore, SMEs historically suffer higher default rates than other sectors, while economic expansion has stagnated at 3.7 percent.

SMEConnect is designed to give applicants real-time tracking capabilities and clear reasons in the event of a loan rejection. Additionally, the platform features a live dashboard that provides the central bank with complete visibility over applications received, processed, approved, disbursed, and rejected at both individual bank and industry-wide levels. A tutorial video is also included on the portal to guide applicants.

Beginning November 1, all SME financing applications must be submitted exclusively through SMEConnect, replacing traditional branch or website visits with a directed link. The central bank has instructed all banks and development finance institutions to prominently display the link on their websites and ensure that their field staff are fully equipped to guide applicants using the system.

stories.title: Italian Military Helicopter Crash in Bosnia Leaves Four Dead
stories.summary:
Four Italian military personnel lost their lives and eleven others sustained injuries when an Italian army helicopter went down in Bosnia and Herzegovina on Thursday. The aircraft, a Boeing CH-47 Chinook carrying fifteen individuals as part of the European Union's EUFOR Althea mission, crashed near the village of Gorice within the Brcko district. According to Italy's Defence Ministry, the victims included Italian army Sergeants Simone Ruggia and Claudio Marchesi, alongside Lieutenant Franco Adriano Zecchillo and Sergeant Laura Procacci of the Italian Red Cross Volunteer Military Corps.

None of the surviving personnel suffered life-threatening injuries following the incident. The ministry confirmed that a dedicated medical team had been dispatched directly from Italy to provide medical assistance on the ground. EUFOR stated that the aircraft was engaged in a routine training exercise at the moment of the accident and announced that a comprehensive investigation would take place to establish the exact cause of the crash.

The incident highlights the ongoing presence and operational duties of international peacekeeping and monitoring missions in the region. EUFOR Althea continues to operate in Bosnia and Herzegovina to maintain a safe and secure environment, utilizing routine patrols and training flights as part of its mandate. Authorities are expected to release further details once the official inquiry into the technical and environmental factors surrounding the crash concludes.

stories.title: تیرہ سال بعد اسلام آباد ماڈل جیل کا تعمیراتی کام ایک تہائی مکمل
stories.summary:
سنہ 2009 میں اسلام آباد میں شروع کیے جانے والے ماڈل جیل کے منصوبے کا تقریباً ایک تہائی حصہ سترہ سال گزرنے کے بعد مکمل ہو چکا ہے۔ سیکٹر ایچ 16 میں نوے ایکڑ رقبے پر پھیلی اس جیل میں قیدیوں کے لیے بیرکس اور دیگر عمارتیں تعمیر ہو چکی ہیں، جن میں اس وقت ساڑھے سات سو قیدیوں کو رکھنے کی گنجائش موجود ہے اور ضرورت پڑنے پر اسے بڑھا کر پندره سو کیا جا سکتا ہے۔

ابھی تک اسلام آباد میں باقاعدہ محکمہ جیل خانہ جات قائم نہیں کیا گیا، تاہم پنجاب کے جیل افسر علی اکبر کو اس ماڈل جیل کا سپرنٹنڈنٹ مقرر کیا گیا ہے جبکہ سکیورٹی کے امور اسلام آباد پولیس کے حوالے ہیں۔ وزارت داخلہ کے مطابق جیل مکمل آپریشنل ہونے کے بعد وہاں رینجرز کے اہلکار بھی تعینات کیے جائیں گے۔ جیل کے اندر جدید مشینری سے لیس ہسپتال، روٹیاں تیار کرنے کا مشینی نظام، قیدیوں اور ملاقاتیوں کے لیے انٹکام پر بات چیت کی سہولت اور خودکار سکیورٹی کیمرے نصب کیے گئے ہیں۔

وزیر مملکت برائے طلّال چوہدری نے بتایا کہ اسلام آباد کی مختلف عدالتوں سے سزایافتہ قیدیوں کو یہاں منتقل کیا جائے گا، اور سابق وزیر اعظم عمران خان بھی ان قیدیوں میں شامل ہیں جنہیں اس ماڈل جیل میں منتقل کیا جائے گا۔ حکام کے مطابق اڈیالہ جیل میں اسلام آباد کے مقدمات کا سامنا کرنے والے تقریباً ساڑھے تین ہزار قیدیوں کو مرحلہ وار اس نئی ماڈل جیل میں منتقل کیا جائے گا اور ابتدائی طور پر ان افراد کو لایا جائے گا جن کے مقدمات زیرِ سماعت ہیں۔

تاہم، جیل کے اس تعمیر شدہ حصے میں تاحال سزائے موت کے قیدیوں کے لیے بیرکس، پھانسی گھاٹ، اور خواتین و بچوں کے لیے مخصوص حصوں کی تعمیر باقی ہے۔ اس جیل کے اندر ہی ججوں کے لیے کورٹ روم اور ریٹائرنگ رومز بھی بنائے گئے ہیں تاکہ یہیں پر جیل ٹرائل کی کارروائی کو آگے بڑھایا جا سکے، جبکہ عملے کے لیے رہائشی کوارٹرز کی تعمیر کا کام آخری مراحل میں ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan State Oil Reports Surge in First Quarter Profit
stories.summary:
Pakistan State Oil announced a substantial profit after tax totaling Rs25.56 billion for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, yielding an earnings per share of Rs54.44. This performance marks a significant increase compared to the Rs9.39 billion profit and Rs20.00 earnings per share recorded during the same period in the previous year. Company leadership attributed the financial growth primarily to higher sales volumes and an improved product mix, which were only partially offset by increased finance costs. Consolidated profit reached Rs29.42 billion, factoring in contributions from Pakistan Refinery Ltd.

The firm experienced a 17.8 percent year-on-year rise in petroleum sales, greatly outpacing the broader industry growth rate of 7.1 percent and expanding its market share by 4.2 percentage points to 45.9 percent. Chief Executive Jawwad Ahmed Cheema highlighted that the company grew at more than twice the speed of the market while successfully sustaining national supplies through severe regional disruptions. Specific product growth included a 23.2 percent increase in petrol sales to reach 968,000 tonnes, and a 12.8 percent rise in high-speed diesel to 759,000 tonnes, defying a general contraction in national diesel demand.

Meanwhile, Wafi Energy Pakistan Ltd reported a profit of Rs6.5 billion for the first nine months of 2026, up from Rs3 billion previously, alongside a dividend announcement of Rs4 per share. The company expanded its footprint by adding 54 Shell retail sites, 26 Shell Select stores, and nine Recharge EV charging stations. In the automotive sector, Indus Motor Company reported net sales rising to Rs74 billion and profits increasing to Rs7.4 billion, though its leadership warned that challenges such as used-car import schemes, policy uncertainty, and geopolitical volatility could affect future outlooks.

stories.title: Lahore High Court Rules IRIS Portal Uploads Invalid for Tax Orders
stories.summary:
The Lahore High Court has ruled that simply uploading an appellate order to the Federal Board of Revenue’s Inland Revenue Information System does not satisfy the legal requirements for valid service under the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001. A division bench comprising Justice Mirza Viqas Rauf and Justice Anwaar Hussain delivered the judgment while deciding three connected reference applications initiated by taxpayer Tahir Mehmood. The applicants had contested decisions by the Appellate Tribunal Inland Revenue, which had previously thrown out their appeals as time-barred under the assumption that uploading the respective orders to the IRIS portal constituted proper legal delivery.

Justice Anwaar Hussain, authoring the court's judgment, explained that Section 218(1)(d) of the ordinance mandates that electronic service must follow a strictly prescribed manner. He pointed out that Rule 74 of the Income Tax Rules explicitly limits electronic addresses to designated fax numbers or email addresses and requires formal confirmation of transmission. In contrast, IRIS functions as an internal, web-based workflow platform for tax administration, meaning that placing a document inside a taxpayer's account fails to fulfill the transmission rules. The court emphasized a clear legal distinction between a document merely being accessible online and it being legally served according to statutory frameworks.

Addressing the tax department's contentions, the bench rejected the argument that taxpayers are obligated to monitor the IRIS portal routinely or that modern technology can bypass foundational legal safeguards. The court noted that pandemic-related explanations provided by one taxpayer regarding travel and quarantine could not be brushed aside. Citing relevant constitutional articles and prior rulings from multiple high courts, the bench set aside the contested tribunal orders and directed the authority to review and decide the underlying appeals afresh strictly on their merits.

stories.title: Pentagon Urges European Allies to Soften Rhetoric Regarding Russia
stories.summary:
Pentagon officials have recently urged several NATO nations, including Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia, to moderate their public statements concerning the threat posed by Russia. Four sources familiar with the discussions indicated that US officials argued certain harsh declarations made by European leaders and government representatives have served to undermine continental security. Delivered during bilateral meetings, these private messages come as the Trump administration attempts to revive diplomatic efforts aimed at achieving a negotiated conclusion to the ongoing war in Ukraine, which is now well into its fifth year. The diplomatic push combines potential sanctions relief for Moscow with pressure on Kyiv to halt attacks on Russian energy infrastructure.

Among the specific remarks that drew concern from US officials were comments from European figures suggesting that Russian President Vladimir Putin is cornered and resorting to desperate measures as the invasion of Ukraine slows. Pentagon policy chief Elbridge Colby was reportedly among the American officials who delivered the message, cautioning a Baltic official that public statements portraying Russia as cornered like a rat are unhelpful and amount to unnecessary provocation. Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal had previously used similar terminology in late September when discussing Russian sabotage efforts in Europe. Despite the private cautioning, European officials noted that the advice felt baffling, particularly given that Baltic intelligence agencies have generally played down the immediate probability of Russia testing NATO's mutual defense provisions, contrasting with warnings from other Western intelligence networks.

The American messaging underscores an ongoing internal debate within NATO regarding the most effective way to communicate threats from an assertive Russia to the public. While some Western officials argue that emphasizing the danger plays directly into Kremlin propaganda designed to sow fear and weaken support for Ukraine, others maintain that governments must remain transparent to justify the resources needed to deter Moscow, especially amid a rising wave of covert sabotage across Europe. Simultaneously, Pentagon planners are reviewing the broader US force posture in Europe, a process that could potentially lead to a significant reduction in American troop levels as Washington shifts greater strategic focus toward threats in the Middle East, Latin America, and East Asia.

stories.title: Pakistan Secure Convincing Six-Wicket Victory Over India in Hong Kong Sixes
stories.summary:
Pakistan defeated India by four wickets during a Group C fixture at the Hong Kong International Sixes tournament held at the Mission Road Ground on Friday. Tasked with chasing a target of 89, Pakistan reached 93 for two in just 3.5 weeks, securing the win with 13 balls remaining. Khawaja Nafay anchored the run chase with a rapid 41 runs from 12 balls, which included five sixes and two fours. Captain Abbas Afridi added 35 runs from eight deliveries before being caught by Natarajan off Shashank Singh. The pair shared a 57-run partnership that secured control of the match, while Abdul Samad and Irfan Khan quickly finished the remaining runs.

Earlier in the match, India batted first and posted a total of 88 for five in their allotted overs. Shashank Singh led the Indian batting lineup with 40 runs from 11 balls, featuring five sixes and two fours. Nitish Rana contributed 19 runs from 14 deliveries, and T Natarajan remained unbeaten with 12 runs off six balls. Despite the late scoring momentum driven by Shashank, the Pakistan bowling attack successfully contained the total. Abdul Samad was the standout bowler for Pakistan, conceding only 10 runs while picking up two wickets in his single over, with teammates Ahmed Daniyal and Muhammad Shahzad claiming one wicket each.

This victory marked Pakistan's first win in two matches, keeping their hopes alive for advancement to the next round of the tournament. The event forms part of the ongoing Hong Kong International Sixes competition, drawing significant attention from cricket fans following the rapid-fire format. The match underscored Pakistan's explosive batting strength, particularly through the aggressive performances of Nafay and Afridi during the short-format contest.

Organizers and participants continue competing in the group stages of the tournament at the Mission Road venue. The quick-fire nature of the competition format allows teams to contest matches rapidly, testing both bowling discipline and power-hitting capabilities under pressure. Pakistan will look to build upon this morale-boosting victory against their regional rivals as they progress further in the tournament.

stories.title: Firefighters Control Blazes at Karachi Furniture Market Near Kamran Chowrangi
stories.summary:
A fire broke out at a furniture market near Kamran Chowrangi in Gulistan-e-Johar, Karachi, on Friday, prompting a response from emergency services. Officials confirmed that four fire tenders and a water bowser were deployed to tackle the blaze, which eventually spread to an adjacent residential building. Chief Fire Officer Humayun Khan stated that the primary fire was brought under control and cooling operations were initiated to stop reignition. Rescue 1122 also confirmed that the extension of the fire into the residential structure was successfully contained, and no casualties or loss of life were reported during the incident.

Shopkeepers at the site expressed frustration regarding the response time of emergency services. Asghar, a local shopkeeper, told media outlets that the market comprised 20 shops and estimated financial losses in the crores of rupees. He claimed that after notifying the Karachi police Madadgar-15 helpline, firefighters took between 15 and 20 minutes to arrive, allowing the flames to spread throughout the commercial area. Asghar noted that the same location had previously been struck by a major fire on December 31, 2024, which destroyed over 30 shops, and pointed out that the market operates on a commercial plot.

This incident follows heightened scrutiny regarding fire safety in Karachi's commercial buildings following a deadly inferno at Gul Plaza in January.
